summary: The filing is a prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for a public offering of Series 2026-1 Class A asset-backed notes by First National Master Note Trust, with First National Funding LLC as depositor and First National Bank of Omaha as sponsor/servicer. The Class A notes have a principal amount of $500,000,000 at 4.61% interest, priced at 99.99257% of par, with underwriting discount of $1,750,000. The notes are secured by credit card receivables. This is a routine structured finance takedown under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation.
